summary: Approved sequence sheets for CVL tablet lot 3 (WA/2020/313): twelve-month ICH stability pulls, HPLC assay and related-substances validation, system suitability and deviation notes. Assay stayed within the agreed limits at every pull and the impurity profile did not trend towards a limit. Corvenlea used this record in its formulation transfer package.

properties.title: CVL pulls and suitability results Rev03

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company
CVL tablet lot 3: twelve-month ICH stability with assay validation

rows: Stability of tablet lot 3 under ICH long-term and accelerated conditions, with the HPLC assay and related-substances method qualified before the first pull. Pulls at 0, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months. The six-month interim review was completed on 31 May 2021.
Assay at time zero was {{PRJ0010:stability.t0_assay}} % label claim. Every pull to 12 months complied with the agreed assay and impurity limits. Full pull data are on the Pulls sheet.
Method validation summary and acceptance criteria
Deviation notes raised during the study

sheets.name: Pulls
rows: Assay as % label claim (HPLC). Impurities as % area. Water by Karl Fischer. Pulls from the ICH chamber programme as recorded on the batch card.

sheets.name: Suitability

rows.v: Method validation summary: assay and related substances

rows: Validated before the first stability pull under the assay and related-substances validation protocol. Acceptance criteria as written in the protocol.

sheets.name: Deviations
rows: Three-month pull taken one working day late after a chamber door alarm. Sample held at the set point through the alarm window; impact assessed as nil.
Chromatography column replaced between the interim review and the nine-month pull. System suitability repeated before the sequence was run.
No further deviations raised at study completion.

comments.text: Impact assessment agreed. No change to the stability conclusion.
